text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by taking the fans' voices too 
much to heart, Cheval Grand frankly 
confides her troubles to Shine Praise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As they talked, Cheval Grand gradually 
remembered her admiration for "great 
Umamusume." To her, Shine Praise revealed 
her plans to transfer overseas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand was shocked, but her 
childhood friend's resolve was firm. For 
the sake of her dream to keep running, she 
made the decision to fly to Australia.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She had always drawn courage from Cheval 
Grand, who kept pushing forward no matter 
how hard it got. To her, Cheval was truly 
a "magnificent Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Cheval Grand returns, with no hesitation 
left in her eyes. Remembering the ideal 
she strives for, she begins training for 
the Kyoto Daishoten!
